about: Radio settings used by local MeshCore meshes. Areas with source 'map' are worked out from the public MeshCore map (map.meshcore.io), where node owners report their settings; they are not confirmed on air. Hand-made areas have no source. To add or correct an area, open a pull request and give a source in the notes.
